top_violation_types.title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §747.603(a)(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One child is missing a health statement.

top_violation_types.title: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering (26 TAC §747.3213(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The primary caregiver did not wash a child's hands after changing there diaper.     This was corrected during the inspection when the caregiver went to wash the child's hands.

top_violation_types.title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §747.5005(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The caregiver did not practice fire drill monthly since 01/2022.

top_violation_types.title: Caregiver Handwashing After Diapering a Child (26 TAC §747.3211(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: After diapering several children, the caregiver did not wash her hands.

top_violation_types.title: Administering Medication - Original Container with Child's Name, Date (26 TAC §747.3605(b)(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: An epi-pen at the operation was not in the original container and was not labeled with the child's full name.

top_violation_types.title: Diaper Changing Equipment - Smooth, Non-absorbent, Easy to Clean Surface (26 TAC §747.3303(a)(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: There was no diaper changing mat available in the home.

top_violation_types.title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Monthly Maintenance Checklist (26 TAC §746.4751(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation has not been documenting their monthly maintenance inspections.

top_violation_types.title: Licensing Incident/Illness Report Form - Injuries Requiring Medical Treatment or Hospitalization (26 TAC §746.701(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Based on information obtained during the investigation, the licensing incident and illness report was not completed.
